description: Use this when the user wants a daily digest or content ideas for a niche, such as "give me today's AI digest" or "content ideas for marketing". Pass niche (ai, developer-tools, startups, marketing, ecommerce, security; leave it out for everything) and optionally limit. Returns the top posts of the last 3 days that are still on their sources' lists, the top 5 for each source, rising keywords, post counts per niche and a link to the digest page.

niche.description: One niche; leave it out for everything

name: trending_digest

as_of.description: ISO 8601 time the data was published by its source or fetched from it. A cached answer keeps the time of its fetch.

engagement.description: The source's own count at the last read, in unit

heat.description: 0 to 100, rank against the other posts of the same source

unit.description: points, reactions, stars or views; null for Product Hunt, which publishes no count
